visual_style_direction.style_reference: High-quality elderly portrait with natural skin texture, realistic eyes, and proper mouth/teeth anatomy
visual_style_direction.mood: Contemplative, dignified, warm but not overly sentimental
visual_style_direction.lighting_approach: Soft directional light with subtle fill, natural skin tones, avoiding harsh shadows or blown highlights

color_palette.accent_colors: Subtle blues in background for depth
color_palette.skin_tone_accuracy: Critical - must match reference subject's natural complexion

composition_requirements.framing: Portrait orientation, head and shoulders visible, adequate headroom
composition_requirements.eye_line: Slightly above center line, natural gaze direction
composition_requirements.background: Simple, non-distracting, shallow depth of field
composition_requirements.avoid: Over-tight crops, top of head cropped, head not fully in frame

character_identity_requirements.identity_fidelity: Must match reference subject's facial structure and features
character_identity_requirements.age_representation: Elderly subject with natural aging signs (wrinkles, skin texture)
character_identity_requirements.expression: Neutral to slightly contemplative, natural mouth position
character_identity_requirements.avoid: Identity drift, unnatural age smoothing, exaggerated expressions

technical_style_parameters.detail_level: High - skin texture, hair strands, fabric weave must be visible
technical_style_parameters.sharpness: Eyes and mouth must be sharp, no blur in critical facial features
technical_style_parameters.noise: Minimal, natural film grain acceptable but not digital artifacts

style_enforcement.style_deviation_tolerance: Low - significant style changes require operator approval
